parameters.name: BakMode
parameters.description:
The back-to-origin mode. Valid values:
- **0**: The default back-to-origin mode. Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium forwards service traffic to the origin server IP address that you specified when you called [CreateNetworkRules](~~157482~~) to create the port forwarding rule.
- **1**: The origin redundancy mode. Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium forwards service traffic to the primary origin server IP address or secondary origin server IP address that you configured by calling [ConfigLayer4RulePolicy](~~312684~~).

parameters.name: Listeners
parameters.description:
The port forwarding rule to configure.

This parameter is a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array represents a created port forwarding rule. You can configure up to one port forwarding rule at a time.

> You can call [DescribeNetworkRules](~~157484~~) to query all created port forwarding rules.

Each port forwarding rule contains the following fields:

- **InstanceId**: String type. Required. The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
- **Protocol**: String type. Required. The forwarding protocol type. Valid values: **tcp**, **udp**.
- **FrontendPort**: Integer type. Required. The Redirection Port.
